headline: 3 Utility Stocks Riding Data Center Power Demand
summary: Data centers are racing to keep up with AI demand, yet the real bottleneck is something far less glamorous than chips: electricity. That tension between digital ambition and physical grid constraints is where potential opportunity emerges for investors watching power infrastructure, grid owners, and utilities exposed to this theme. This article walks through three stocks from our screener that sit close to this fault line and explains how the recent news could matter for each one. The three...
